code_first.q: Trace a decision checking whether an IPv4 octet is in the valid numerical range.
code_first.code:
octet = 260
if octet >= 0 AND octet <= 255 then
    print("Valid range")
else
    print("Out of range")
endif
p: Predict the message and identify the flowchart decision.
Change octet to 255 and predict again.
Explain why an IPv4 octet must be between 0 and 255; note that one valid octet does not validate a complete address.
code_first.a: 260 produces Out of range; 255 gives Valid range. The decision checks octet >= 0 AND octet <= 255. One IPv4 octet contains eight bits and represents 0–255; a whole IPv4 address contains four octets.
